only_placeholders.instructions: Every secret-looking value in this example configuration file is a placeholder rather than a real credential.

criteria.true: Every field that would hold a secret contains an obvious stand-in: an empty value, angle brackets, an ALL_CAPS name, or wording telling the reader to replace it
criteria.false: At least one field holds what looks like a genuine credential: a long high-entropy string, a JWT, or a real session cookie. Surrounding words such as example or placeholder do NOT make a genuine-looking value a placeholder
